en: Clarify Agent runtime type ownership, split the internal execution context into narrow contracts, add explicit Zod and JSON Schema tool authoring types, and align wire-safe user input and sandbox context schemas.
zh-CN: 明确 Agent 运行时类型所有权，将内部执行上下文拆分为窄契约，新增显式的 Zod 与 JSON Schema 工具定义类型，并对齐 wire-safe 用户输入与 sandbox context schema。
